title: Write 17 · 难 跑 五 远 歌 元 介 绍 六 唱 名 字 南 北 京
focus: 难 跑 五 远 歌 元 介 绍 六 唱 名 字 南 北 京
body:
Numbers, names and compass points: 五, 六, 名字, 介绍, 唱歌, 南, 北, 北京.

## Repeating parts
- **口 mouth**: on the left of 唱 and inside 名 and 京.
- **元**: by itself and inside 远 (元 + 辶).
- **亠 lid**: on top of 六 and 京.
- **哥 / 可**: 歌 = 哥 + 欠 (yawn, breath). Singing comes from an open mouth.

## Rules that matter here
- **Left before right:** in 北, write the left half (丨, 一, ㇀), then the right (丿, 乚).
- **辶 last:** 远.

cards.Notes: 又 hand + 隹 zhuī bird. 10 strokes. 又 (㇇, ㇏) first, then 隹 (丿, 丨, 丶, 一, 一, 丨, 一, 一). Read nàn in 灾难 (disaster).
𧾷 foot + 包 bāo (phonetic). 12 strokes. 𧾷 (口, then 丨, 一, 丨, ㇀) first, then 包 (勹 around 巳).
4 strokes: 一, a slanted 丨, ㇕ fold, then the long bottom 一 last. Inside 语's 吾.
元 yuán (phonetic) + 辶 walk: far to walk. 7 strokes. 元 (一, 一, 丿, 乚) first, then 辶 last. Lookalike 近 jìn (near) has 斤.
哥 gē (phonetic) + 欠 open mouth. 14 strokes. Write 哥 (two 可 stacked; the top one has no hook), then 欠 (丿, ㇇, 丿, ㇏).
二 over 儿. 4 strokes: 一, 一, 丿, 乚. It is the phonetic in 远 and 玩.
人 over 丿 and 丨. 4 strokes: 丿, ㇏, then the left 丿, then the right 丨.
纟 silk + 召 zhào (phonetic). 8 strokes. 纟 (𠃋, 𠃋, ㇀), then 召 (刀 over 口).
亠 lid (丶, 一) over 八. 4 strokes: 丶, 一, 丿, 丶.
口 mouth + 昌 chāng (phonetic). 11 strokes. 口, then 昌: a narrow 日 over a wider 日.
夕 evening + 口 mouth: calling your name in the dark. 6 strokes. 夕 (丿, ㇇, 丶), then 口 tucked under it.
宀 roof + 子 child (zǐ, phonetic). 6 strokes. 宀 (丶, 丶, 乛), then 子 (乛, 亅, 一). Lookalike 学 has ⺍ and 冖 on top.
9 strokes: 十 (一, 丨), then 冂 (丨, 𠃌), then 丷 inside, then 干 (一, 一, 丨). The final 丨 sits inside the frame.
Two people back to back. 5 strokes. Left half first (丨, 一, ㇀), then the right half (丿, 乚). Compare 比 bǐ (two 匕 facing the same way).
亠 + 口 + 小. 8 strokes, top to bottom. 小 is centre first: 亅, then the left and right dots.
